risks.risk: Model/variant mismatch (seller says ZZR, but photos only partially suggest Kawasaki; wrong model changes value and parts compatibility).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model/variant badge/label (or VIN/engine number plate) plus a full side profile photo showing the tank/side fairing/seat styling.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used Kawasaki sport bike with unknown exact ZZR variant (worst-case for value).

risks.risk: Not actually working (electrical/engine/transmission issues not visible in still photos).
risks.proof: Short video: cold start, steady idle, blip throttle, upshift/downshift through gears, and a brake test (front + rear) showing stopping.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven/assume potential faults until tested (worst-case: treat as needing inspection/repair).

risks.risk: Brake system condition unknown (pads/rotor thickness/fluid leaks not confirmed).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of brake caliper and pad thickness + rotor condition, and a video of braking from low speed.
risks.if_unproven: Price as brakes may need service (worst-case: pads/bleed/rotor wear).

risks.risk: Rust/corrosion or damage hidden (photos show grime; cannot confirm frame/engine casing condition).
risks.proof: Photos of frame underside, engine casing close-ups, and both sides of the bike in good light.
risks.if_unproven: Price as possible corrosion/damage present (worst-case: treat as used with cosmetic/maintenance wear).

risks.risk: Original parts claim may be false (aftermarket exhaust/controls/tires can reduce value).
risks.proof: Close-ups of exhaust branding/part markings, tire brand/model, and any non-stock components; plus receipts if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price as parts may be non-original (worst-case: assume aftermarket where not verifiable).

proof_requests: Clear photo of VIN/engine number plate (and any model badge) + odometer reading close-up.
Video of cold start and riding test: gear shifting (up/down), front and rear brake test.
Full side profile (both sides) and rear shot to confirm exact ZZR variant and condition.
Close-ups of tires (brand/model + tread), brake pads/rotor condition, and exhaust/engine markings.
response.reason: The photos suggest a Kawasaki sport bike, but the exact ZZR model and the seller’s “working fine / perfect gears & brakes / no rust / all original” claims cannot be verified remotely from still images. Missing decisive proof prevents a confident worst-case price.
